About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to help translate our products, their value propositions, and our broader brand strategy into audience-specific, globally relevant marketing programs. You’ll shape how people discover, understand, adopt, and engage with our products across markets and stages of the customer journey. You’ll connect product narratives, audience insight, cultural context, and business goals into strategies that make advanced technology feel clear, useful, and human.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for a marketer who understands how product marketing, brand strategy, audience research, and international growth work together. You’ll develop segmentation frameworks, lifecycle and go-to-market programs, regional insights, and partnership opportunities; then work across product marketing, growth, creative, partnerships, analytics, and regional teams to bring them to life. Your work will connect launches, product education, customer engagement, and ongoing storytelling into a coherent journey from awareness to advocacy.

To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance craft with decisiveness.

In this role, you will:

- Translate complex product capabilities, use cases, and value propositions into clear, differentiated messaging that is relevant to distinct audiences without losing accuracy, nuance, or the product’s ambition.

- Develop audience segmentation frameworks based on customer needs, behaviors, use cases, regions, industries, and stages of the customer journey.

- Create audience-specific messaging and campaign strategies for groups such as creators, builders, professionals, students, consumers, and emerging-market users.

- Lead cross-functional marketing programs end to end for defined audiences or initiatives, with minimal oversight, setting priorities across awareness, acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and advocacy.

- Lead research efforts including customer interviews, surveys, social listening, competitive analysis, market trends, and behavioral data.

- Turn research and performance signals into actionable audience personas, messaging frameworks, briefs, campaign recommendations, and market insights.

- Identify cultural, regional, and language-specific opportunities across global markets, and help adapt global campaigns for local audiences while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

- Develop go-to-market plans for new campaigns, product features, audience programs, partnerships, and market expansions.

- Identify partnership opportunities with creators, developers, communities, platforms, industry groups, and other audience ecosystems.

- Align partners across product marketing, growth, CRM, creative, analytics, partnerships, and regional marketing; resolve tradeoffs and shape creative direction to deliver coordinated customer journeys.

- Measure campaign and audience performance, using data to improve messaging, segmentation, customer journeys, regional strategies, and future marketing investments.

- Build reusable campaign processes and playbooks, and coach peers and junior teammates to improve planning, creative collaboration, and execution.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 5–8 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, audience strategy, partnerships, or related fields.

- Bring deep familiarity with AI products, foundation models, generative AI capabilities and limitations, and common user workflows; this is a critical qualification for the role.

- Have experience translating complex technology and technical product capabilities into clear, compelling, differentiated customer value propositions.

- Are a strategic thinker who can turn audience insight, cultural context, product strategy, and business goals into a compelling point of view and an actionable marketing system.

- Can move fluidly between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution: building the framework, writing the brief, launching the program, and reviewing results.

NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience working with creators, developers, communities, partnerships, or other distinct customer segments.

- Experience working across cultures, regions, or international markets.

- Experience with experimentation, performance measurement, social listening, and translating signals into strategic recommendations.

- Experience in consumer technology, emerging products, developer tools, enterprise products, or other fast-changing categories.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Go To Market ("GTM") Systems builds and runs the platform that Sales and contracting operate on, a production Salesforce org plus a growing portfolio of custom internal applications and agents. These systems process revenue-impacting transactions, guide critical business processes, and produce data the rest of the company runs on. Today the path from request, development, test, and pull request to production push is manual and slows the team down rather than speeding it up.

We are hiring a DevOps / AgentOps engineer to build and run that path. You will stand up and maintain an AI-first CI/CD pipeline covering both Salesforce and custom application code. This release pipeline will support three modes: fully agentic, human-in-the-loop, and AI-assisted. Anthropic is an unusual place to do this. Our own frontier models are part of the toolkit and the question we want you to answer is what a delivery system looks like when you design it for agents and humans working side by side rather than retrofitting agents into a pipeline built for humans alone.

You will work closely with a team of business systems analysts, software engineers, and integration engineers to develop the solution to accelerate their everyday work. The pipeline you build is the one path to production for a system under audit, so the guardrails, approvals, and audit trail are part of the product, not an afterthought.

Key responsibilities

We're looking for a Senior Vice President, Strategy to lead and evolve our strategy practice across the Americas. This executive leader will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, shape strategic pursuits, define market-leading offerings, elevate Valtech's industry presence, and build an AI-native strategy function that drives measurable business impact.

• Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data

Executive Client Advisory

• Lead strategic pursuit narratives from opportunity identification through final client presentations.

Offering Development

• Transform market and client insights into scalable, repeatable service offerings.
• Define how strategy, brand, data activation, personalization, and AI offerings are packaged, positioned, and sold.
• Continuously evolve offerings in response to changes in technology, AI capabilities, and market demand.
• Partner across practices to ensure integrated solutions and consistent client experiences.

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

• Represent Valtech at industry conferences, executive forums, analyst briefings, and client events.
• Develop original intellectual property, research, and thought leadership content.
• Build awareness of Valtech's AI-native positioning and experience innovation capabilities.
• Strengthen relationships with analysts, strategic partners, and key industry influencers.

Practice Leadership

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of strategists across the Americas.
• Establish scalable operating models, tools, and ways of working for the strategy practice.
• Partner closely with Creative, Data & AI, and Technology leaders to deliver integrated client outcomes.
• Define and implement AI-native approaches to research, synthesis, strategic development, pursuit support, and practice operations.
• Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

• Significant experience in strategy consulting, digital consulting, business transformation, or a related advisory discipline.
• Proven success advising CMOs, marketing leaders, and executive stakeholders on business growth and transformation initiatives.
• Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with CIOs and technology leaders on the relationship between technology investments and business outcomes.

• Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary pursuits from qualification through deal closure.
• Strong track record of building and scaling high-performing strategy or advisory teams.

• Proven ability to establish and scale AI-enabled or AI-native approaches within strategy and consulting environments.
• Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
• Ability to navigate complex, matrixed organizations and influence stakeholders across multiple functions

Nice to have qualifications

• External market presence through speaking engagements, published thought leadership, analyst engagement, or industry participation.

• Experience working across brand, marketing, data, and technology transformation initiatives.

• Established relationships with strategic alliance or technology partners.

• Experience supporting global clients and large-scale transformation programs.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

The benefits

This is a Full time position based in Canada. The offered salary range is $170,000 CAD - $230, 000 CAD annually, depending on experience and location.

Valtech offers a comprehensive benefits package effective after three months of continuous service:

• A comprehensive insurance plan, where you can choose the module that best suits your needs—Gold, Silver, or Bronze. The employer may contribute up to 80% of your coverage depending on the selected module. This plan includes short- and long-term disability coverage.

• We close during the winter holidays and offer flexible scheduling throughout the year, so you can enjoy those sunny Friday afternoons—provided your weekly hours are completed.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Position Purpose: The Sr. Data Scientist, Experimentation Science owns the statistical foundation of how The Home Depot learns from its online customers. Every year the Online organization runs experiments that decide what ships, what gets rebuilt and what gets abandoned. This role makes those decisions trustworthy. You own the inference methods behind the results, the diagnostics that catch a broken test before anyone reads it, and the design guidance that gets product teams to a well-powered, well-instrumented experiment before a single customer is exposed. The work happens at two altitudes. At the methods altitude, you define and validate the statistical approach used across online experimentation: estimator choice, variance reduction, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, and causal inference where randomization is not possible. At the team altitude, you sit with product managers, engineers, designers and merchants to shape hypotheses, size effects honestly, and interpret results without overclaiming. You are the person who says the test cannot answer that question at this traffic, and the person who says this result is real and we should act on it. This role also builds the AI layer that scales the practice. Experimentation is full of high-volume, judgment-adjacent work: design review, instrumentation checks, readout drafting, anomaly triage. You will design, build and evaluate LLM-based and agentic workflows that absorb that work, so the team's scientists spend their time on the questions that need a human. That means writing the tooling, defining how it connects to our data and platforms, and holding it to an evaluation standard as rigorous as the one you apply to experiments. Success is measured by decision quality and experiment velocity together: more tests, faster, that leaders actually believe. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical influence, setting the standards that other data scientists and analysts across the Online organization follow. Participate in the continuous improvement of data science and analytics by developing replicable solutions (for example, codified data products, project documentation, process flowcharts) to ensure solutions are leveraged for future projects; Define best practices and develop clear vision for data analysis and model productionalization; Contribute to library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensuring developed codes are documented Direct Manager/Direct Reports: This position reports to manager or above This position has 0 Direct Reports Travel Requirements: Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time. At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. • Experience developing and optimizing large codebases, with the ability to make tradeoffs between usability, performance, and power

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

BitGo is looking for a design leader who still designs. You will manage and mentor the design team, own the design system, and sit next to the Chief Product Officer on business strategy.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it literally. You will carry your own design surfaces and ship them, alongside leading the team. Expect roughly 50% hands-on IC work to start, decreasing as the team scales. It will not go to zero — the person setting the craft bar should be practicing at it.

We are not a design-forward company today. We intend to become one, and we want you to lead that shift.

The team you will lead

The design team is small, senior, and self-sufficient. Each designer owns a wide vertical outright — trading, staking, DeFi vaults, earn, wallets, financing — with deep product context and strong opinions about the work. They are running at capacity, which is part of why this role carries real IC load: you will pick up the retail mobile experience and design system rather than distributing that work across a team that is already full.

What they have asked for is specific, and we are hiring against it: a leader who gets into the work early with product and engineering rather than arriving at the end, who can critique craft because they still practice it, who tells them plainly what the next level requires, and who gives the team air cover so they can do the deep work instead of patching to hit dates.

What you will own

• Your own design work. You will own surfaces directly and ship them at the quality bar you are asking of everyone else. Discovery through spec, in Figma, in the reviews, on the hard problems.
• The team's growth. Invest in each designer individually. Be explicit about what the next level requires and give people the work that gets them there. Feedback should be candid, specific, and about the craft. Respect the ownership designers already have — autonomy is how this team works best, and your job is to raise the ceiling, not take the pen.
• Design's standing in the company. Amplify the team's visibility, voice, and strategic impact. Represent design in strategy, roadmap, and architecture conversations, and push for the client experience when nobody else in the room will.
• Upstream involvement. Join product and engineering at discovery, not at handoff. Shape long-term roadmaps with PMs so the team builds toward a direction instead of absorbing late changes.
• The design system. Own the system and component library end to end: tokens, patterns, governance, contribution model, and adoption across product teams. Translate company strategy into a system flexible enough that teams ship scalable experiences rather than one-off patches.
• Systems design. Our platform spans seven product areas with shared primitives — accounts, wallets, assets, entitlements, approvals. Design the system, not the screen.
• The discipline. Establish UX and systems thinking as a practice the whole organization runs on, not a stage a design team owns. Product managers, engineers, and business leads should be able to frame a client problem, map the system it lives in, and evaluate a solution against real client needs. That is how we ship value to every client type we serve, in every market we operate in — rather than a set of features that work for the loudest account.
• How we work. Establish the processes a small team needs to move fast without losing quality: critique, documentation, design review, and clean handoffs with engineering. Set the quality bar and hold it, including for AI-assisted work.
• Technical depth. Read a technical design, understand the constraint, and decide with engineering where to compromise, where to hold, and where a broader change is worth the cost. Get into the mechanics with the team on the hard edge cases — the crypto ones and the design ones.
• The face of design. Be present and known internally, and represent BitGo design externally with clients, partners, and candidates.

What success looks like

By six months: the design system has a clear owner, a versioned component library, and measurable adoption. Product teams stop reinventing patterns. You have shipped design work of your own that the team points to as the standard. Every designer knows what their next level requires and has work that supports getting there.

By 12 months: design is in the room early on strategy, not late on execution. Product and engineering partners frame problems in client terms without being asked. The team has grown in size and capability. At least one flagship surface has shipped with a coherent, systemized experience clients notice.

Who you are

• Experience leading design in financial services. Digital assets, or another domain of genuinely complex technical flows, strongly preferred.
• You have built and owned a design system at scale, not just used one.
• Hands-on in Figma and a role model for craft. You are shipping design work today, not describing work you shipped four years ago. You can sit in a critique and give feedback that is specific enough to act on.
• Deep in UX. Strong product thinking, logical reasoning, and decisions grounded in data rather than taste alone.
• You have managed designers and made them better. You care about how the team is doing, not only what it ships.
• Technically literate. Comfortable with APIs, data models, and engineering trade-offs.
• Direct communicator. You can hold a position with a Chief Product Officer, an engineering lead, or a client, and change your mind when the argument is better.
• You want the mandate. Turning a technical, compliance-heavy platform into a design-led one is the appeal, not the obstacle.

Helpful, not required

• Regulated environments: broker-dealer, trust company, bank, or qualified custodian.
• Experience with complex permissioning, approval workflows, or multi-entity account structures.
• Design leadership at a company that went through the same shift you would lead here.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

• Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options
• 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
• Up to 4% 401k company match
• Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
• Free commuter/parking pass
• Free custom lunches and snacks
• Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
• Great colleagues and an inspiring environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $210,000 and $250,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Detection Engineering(DE) 팀은 쿠팡 보안조직(Digital Trust) 내에서 보안 위협의 탐지와 대응 자동화를 엔드투엔드로 설계하고 구현하는 팀입니다. 위협 시나리오 정의부터 로그 수집, 탐지 룰 배포, AI 기반 자동 대응까지 전 주기를 한 팀에서 커버하며, Detection-as-Code 철학을 기반으로 모든 탐지 로직을 코드로 관리합니다.
DE팀은 AI 기술을 각 도메인에 적극적으로 접목하고 있습니다. AI-SOC를 직접 구현하고, 보안 로그의 AI 기반 분석, LLM을 활용한 자동화 등, AI는 별도 기능이 아닌 팀 전체의 업무 방식에 내재되어 있습니다.
이 포지션은 SIEM과 SOAR를 아우르는 보안 탐지·자동화 전 영역에서 깊은 기술적 전문성을 발휘하는 역할입니다. 데이터 파이프라인부터 탐지 엔진, 자동화 워크플로우, AI-SOC까지 DE팀의 기술 스택 전체를 관통하는 시야로 아키텍처 설계와 기술적 난제 해결에 기여합니다.

이런 분과 함께하고 싶습니다

• 하나의 도메인에 갇히지 않고, 데이터부터 자동화까지 전체를 조망할 수 있는 분
• "이게 왜 이렇게 되어 있지?"라는 질문에서 시작해 아키텍처를 개선한 경험이 있는 분
• 직접 코드를 쓰면서도, 동료 엔지니어에게 좋은 영향을 주는 분
• 복잡한 문제를 단순하게 정리하고, 명확한 근거로 방향을 제시할 수 있는 분

업무 내용

• 보안 데이터 플랫폼(SIEM) 및 자동화 플랫폼(SOAR) 전체 아키텍처에 대한 기술적 방향 수립 및 설계
• 대규모 보안 로그 파이프라인의 안정성, 성능, 비용 효율성에 대한 아키텍처 레벨의 문제 해결
• SOAR 워크플로우 및 AI-SOC 체계의 설계, 기술적 난제 해결, 품질 기준 정의
• Detection-as-Code 프레임워크의 고도화 — 탐지 룰 라이프사이클, 테스트 자동화, 배포 파이프라인 개선
• 보안 솔루션 선정·도입·교체에 대한 기술적 평가
• 전사 보안 아키텍처 변경, 신규 시스템 도입 시 DE 관점의 기술 자문 및 영향도 분석
• AI/LLM 기반 보안 자동화의 아키텍처 설계

자격 요건

• 보안 엔지니어링 또는 보안 인프라 분야 경력 10년 이상
• SIEM 플랫폼의 아키텍처, 데이터 파이프라인, 탐지 엔진에 대한 깊은 기술적 이해 — 구축부터 대규모 운영, 성능 최적화, 마이그레이션까지 경험
• SOAR 또는 보안 자동화 플랫폼의 설계·구축·운영 경험 — 워크플로우 설계 원칙, 솔루션 연동 아키텍처, 장애 대응 체계에 대한 실무 역량
• Python 기반의 개발 역량 — 프로토타이핑에서 프로덕션 수준의 코드까지 작성할 수 있는 엔지니어
• 다양한 보안 솔루션(EDR, CTI, 티켓 시스템, 클라우드 보안 서비스 등)의 동작 원리와 연동 방식에 대한 폭넓은 실무 경험
• AI/LLM 기반 보안 자동화 또는 AI-SOC 시스템에 대한 이해 — LLM Agent 아키텍처, 프롬프트 설계, 자동 분석/판단 워크플로우 구축 경험
• 복잡한 기술적 문제를 구조화하고, 트레이드오프를 명확히 정리할 수 있는 역량
• SIEM과 SOAR를 모두 깊이 있게 다뤄본 경험 — 두 영역의 접점에서 아키텍처 의사결정을 내려본 경험
• 클라우드 환경(AWS 등)에서의 대규모 시스템 아키텍처 설계 및 운영 경험

우대 사항
